cont_single_line_comment.comment: This is the Node.js test driver for the standard Apache Thrift test service. The driver invokes every function defined in the Thrift Test service with a representative range of parameters.  The ThriftTestDriver function requires a client object connected to a server hosting the Thrift Test service and supports an optional callback function which is called with a status message when the test is complete.
